description: Set whether the robot vacuums, mops or does both, optionally with a suction level and water flow. Omitted levels keep the current non-off value. Values outside the configured supported lists are rejected with 422 before dispatch.

mode.description: What a cleaning robot does: vacuum only, mop only, or vacuum and mop together. CUSTOM is a vendor-specific setting with no Port OS name (for example per-room settings); devices report it but do not accept it.

suctionLevel.description: Vacuum suction level, ordered from off to strongest. CUSTOM is a vendor-specific setting with no Port OS name (for example per-room settings); devices report it but do not accept it.

waterFlow.description: Mop water flow level, ordered from off to highest. CUSTOM is a vendor-specific setting with no Port OS name (for example per-room settings); devices report it but do not accept it.
